planet.name: Setesh
planet.summary: Setesh is the starter moon for all new avatars since 19.0.0 (16 Sep 2025), replacing Thule. Its hub is Port Cabrakan. A main mission chain teaches the basics and hands out free starter gear before you move on to Calypso.
planet.howToReach: New accounts start here. Existing players: talk to the Setesh shuttle pilot near the Port Atlantis teleporter on Calypso, use the VTOL at Camp Icarus (if eligible), pick Setesh in a space station teleporter list, or fly to Setesh Space Station.
warnings: Storage is per planet: items stored on Setesh stay on Setesh. Empty your Setesh storage before leaving.
Leaving a second time is confusing: the Setesh teleporters do not list Calypso, and token teleports from the station cost tokens. Use the leave/skip terminal instead (see 'Leave Setesh').
MindArk noted weak performance in Port Cabrakan and Outpost Bacab at launch (19.0.0); not confirmed fixed.
Some Setesh rewards are not given to avatars that already finished Thule (19.0.0).

activities.title: Get to Setesh (existing players)
activities.summary: New avatars start on Setesh automatically. Older avatars can visit to collect the starter rewards: a shuttle pilot near the Port Atlantis teleporter takes you there, the Camp Icarus VTOL works if you qualify, or you can fly to Setesh Space Station.
steps: On Calypso, go to the Port Atlantis teleporter, head down the stairs past the service center and talk to the pilot at the top of a short stair (players, Mar 2026).
Or use the VTOL at Camp Icarus: MindArk staff said this needs Mentor skill 2+ or a highest combat profession of 5 or lower.
Or fly/teleport to Setesh Space Station (scroll the station teleporter list) and teleport down for free.
rewards: Access to the Setesh starter chain

locations.label: Setesh Shuttle Pilot near Port Atlantis teleporter (fan map lists about 61138, 74137 on Calypso)

score.rationale: Free trip to free starter gear.

warnings: A Sep 2025 MindArk preview said existing players can travel to Setesh anytime without requirements, but staff later listed VTOL requirements. The shuttle pilot route is newer (players, Mar 2026).

activities.title: Main chain: Security Chief Harkov ('A New Arrival')
activities.summary: The core Setesh chain starts with Security Chief Harkov in Port Cabrakan. It walks you through combat, looting, healing, armor, vehicles and the different biomes, and hands out starter gear along the way.
steps: Talk to Security Chief Harkov in Port Cabrakan and accept 'A New Arrival'.
Follow the chain through Setesh's areas and outposts; teleporters unlock as you go.
Finish the chain; Harkov then offers a one-way trip to Calypso.
rewards: Standard Undersuit (if you never had one)
Starter pistols, rifles and swords (stronger versions as you progress)

cost.text: Free; ammo is provided for the combat parts.

activities.limits: One-time chain. Some rewards are withheld from avatars that completed Thule.

score.rationale: Free gear and the fastest way to learn the game.

warnings: 19.10.1 lowered the TT value of newly granted onboarding armor and moved ammo rewards around.

activities.title: 'Recon In The Jungle': Vivo S10 healing tool
activities.summary: A mission in the Setesh chain gives the Vivo S10 first-aid tool (it used to come from the Gauntlet on Calypso). Since 19.10.1 it has a 2 PED TT value. Players call the Setesh healing tools very economical.
steps: Progress the Setesh chain until 'Recon In The Jungle'.
Complete it to receive the Vivo S10.

score.rationale: A durable healing tool every newcomer needs.

activities.title: Port Cabrakan mission for an Adjusted SET-P1 Civilian Sidearm
activities.summary: A mission added in Port Cabrakan (19.2.0) leads to an Adjusted version of the SET-P1 Civilian Sidearm, the starter pistol.
steps: Ask around Port Cabrakan for the SET-P1 mission (giver not named in the notes).
Complete it for the Adjusted SET-P1.
warnings: Mission name, giver and steps are not in the release notes.

activities.title: 'Cliffchaser Run' then 'Small Iron' (Paul Reinhardt)
activities.summary: After 'Cliffchaser Run', Paul Reinhardt offers the mission 'Small Iron'. Since 19.12.0 (Nov 2026) you no longer have to leave Setesh first.
steps: Complete 'Cliffchaser Run'.
Talk to Paul Reinhardt to receive 'Small Iron'.

activities.title: 'Savannah Survey' mining intro (Hunraqan)
activities.summary: A mining introduction mission in Hunraqan on Setesh. Since 19.0.2 it is also open to avatars who finished Thule's 'Prospective Prospector'.
steps: Find the giver in Hunraqan.
Accept 'Savannah Survey' and follow the probing steps.
warnings: A player (Dec 2025) reported getting the mission without probes or a finder; bring your own if needed.

activities.title: Trader Joel daily hand-in (Port Cabrakan)
activities.summary: Trader Joel in Cabrakan offers a daily hand-in mission: bring items he asks for and get a reward. MindArk described Setesh hand-ins as trading hunting loot for a chance at something more valuable.
steps: Find Trader Joel in Cabrakan.
Check which items he wants today.
Hand them in.
rewards: Varies; chance at something more valuable

cost.text: The items you hand in (often your own loot).

cooldown.resetNote: A community tracker uses a 24 h timer for the Setesh daily NPC; MindArk gives no timer.

score.rationale: Small daily use for starter loot.

warnings: The 24 h timer is from a fan tool, not MindArk.

activities.title: Free starter fishing gear mission
activities.summary: Since Fishing launched (15 Apr 2026) a Setesh mission gives a basic set of fishing gear, and you can fish in Setesh's waters.
steps: Look for the fishing mission giver on Setesh.
Complete it to get starter gear.
Fish in any Setesh water.

score.rationale: Free start in a new profession.

warnings: Giver name not given in the post.

activities.title: Hunt safely on Setesh
activities.summary: Most Setesh creatures are level 1-3, but a few spots hold much stronger animals: Seteshian Atrox (players saw L35, L52, L60) and Seteshian Altaik (L82, L88) around the lake. Setesh creature loot was widened in May 2026 to include more gear.
steps: Stick to low-level spawns until your gear improves.
Avoid the Atrox and Altaik spots until much later.
Every new Setesh creature also starts a Codex challenge.
warnings: Mob levels are from a Sep 2025 player map; spawns may have changed.

activities.title: Leave Setesh for Calypso
activities.summary: When the main chain is done, Harkov offers a one-way trip to Calypso (you land in Port Atlantis, the next newcomer hub). If you come back later, the Setesh teleporters do not list Calypso; use the leave/skip terminal inside the building opposite the Cabrakan teleporter instead.
steps: Empty your Setesh storage first (storage is per planet).
First time: take Harkov's one-way trip after the chain.
Later visits: paste the waypoint below in chat, go into the building with the terminals opposite the Cabrakan teleporter, and use the red terminal at the back; confirm leaving.
Avoid the token route via Setesh Space Station (10 tokens to Calypso's station hangar) unless you have tokens.
rewards: Free trip to Port Atlantis, Calypso

cost.text: Free via Harkov or the terminal.

score.rationale: Saves newcomers from being stuck or paying tokens.

warnings: The terminal and waypoint come from players (Dec 2025 and Mar 2026), not MindArk.

activities.title: Setesh Space Station
activities.summary: Setesh has its own space station with a non-PvP zone around it (19.0.2). Teleporting down from the station to Setesh works for free; jumps to other stations or planets cost Teleportation Tokens.
steps: Pick 'Setesh Space Station' in a Setesh teleporter to go up.
Teleport down from the station to Setesh for free.
Leaving for another world from here needs tokens or a ship.

cost.text: Free down; tokens for other destinations.

score.rationale: Mostly useful once you own a ship.

warnings: Players reported lootable PvP outside the station before the 19.0.2 safe zone; stay inside the safe zone without a ship.

activities.title: After Setesh: continue on Calypso
activities.summary: MindArk made Port Atlantis the landing point after Setesh (19.2.0) and added a new Port Atlantis newcomer mission chain across Calypso in 19.12.0. The operator of the Howling Mine also advertises a free shuttle from Setesh to its space hub.
steps: Arrive in Port Atlantis and look for the newcomer missions there.
Optional: try the Howling Mine free ship tutorial for space.

score.rationale: Points you to the next free content.

warnings: The Setesh-to-Howling-Mine shuttle is only claimed on the operator's own site; not confirmed in MindArk notes.
